This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 98 of 2023 registered at Police Station Daboh, District Bhind (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 376 (D), 366 (A), 368 and 392 of IPC, Section 16/17 of POCSO Act,
Section 11/13 of MPDVPK Act and Sections 25, 27 of Arms Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is innocent and h a s been falsely implicated.
Entire prosecution story in respect to present applicant - accused is improbable.
Allegedly, preosecutrix got missing on 20.5.2023 and was recovered on 23.6.2023.

After recovery on 23.6.2023, in her first statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., prosecutrix had not made any allegation against the applicant, however, in her second statement recorded on 22.7.2023, she made allegations against the applicant for the first time.

Under these circumstances, the statements of the Abhishek Jha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111863839/
1 prosecutrix becomes doubtful.

sentences.text: DNA report is also not corroborative.
Further argument is that applicant is in custody since 29.4.2024.
Co-accused Deepak has already been granted bail by this Court by order dated 01.3.2024 passed in MCRC No. 8984 of 2024.
Hence, prayed for grant of bail to the applicant.
On the other hand, learned State counsel opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) along with one local surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/Committal Court.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE AKS Abhishek Jha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111863839/
